---
title: Where the fun starts
---

This is a portal developed out as a Course Set where core learning modules exist. Please see sidebar menu for specific modules.
There is a logic to the order as modules build as you go down the list, though they are developed where they are also stand-alone.

## Organism Biology

If you are new to marine invertebrates, start here. The **Organism Biology** section covers the fundamental biology of the animals the lab works on — oysters, clams, mussels, sea stars, and corals — assuming no background in invertebrate zoology:

-   [Start Here](biology/index.qmd) — how the three phyla relate to each other, what each group brings, and the traits they share that shape every experiment the lab runs.
-   [Cross-Cutting Themes](biology/04-cross-cutting.qmd) — the fastest single-page orientation, and the bridge into the conceptual framework below.
-   [Glossary](biology/glossary.qmd) and [Reading List](biology/reading-list.qmd) — for terms you hit in the first week, and for going deeper.

## Lab Science

Beyond the technical modules, the **Lab Science** section holds the conceptual grounding for what we do:

-   [Gene Expression and DNA Methylation](framework/gene-expression-methylation.qmd) — start here if you know the central dogma but are new to gene regulation, gene-body methylation, or methylation assays.
-   [Lab Conceptual Framework](framework/conceptual-framework.qmd) — how the lab defines environmental memory, resilience, and predictive phenotyping in marine organisms, including the mechanistic channels we work on and the questions we treat as open.
-   [Foundational Papers](framework/foundational-papers.qmd) — annotated index of the seven anchor papers the framework is distilled from, with PDFs where licensing allows.

If you want to contribute, have suggestions, want to see additional resources related to data science, or learn more about what our lab does please visit the [about page](about.qmd).
